what_results_support: On the same FloorPlan1/seed29/Apple case, the guarded active path verifies stale memory, mutates the memory snapshot, and completes a non-TeleportFull stepwise PickupObject bridge.
The high-threshold no-verify control follows the same live revisit instrumentation but is not selected for verification, does not mutate memory, and does not execute the guarded task bridge.
The control confirms the current runner gates task-bridge execution on detector-backed memory refresh.
what_results_do_not_support: No passive-vs-active policy superiority claim: passive task execution is not implemented here, so this is a guarded-path control rather than a performance baseline.
No statistical navigation/task success, manipulation benchmark, persistent writeback, cross-platform transfer, or broad active-maintenance claim.
claim_boundary: Single-case guarded-path comparison only: active verify/update path completes, high-threshold no-verify control does not execute the guarded bridge. Not active-vs-passive task-performance superiority.
